senses.gloss: m.mahir, a fabulous animal of gigantic dimensions.
units: Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ bot. [read:] מהו מותר לגדל א״ר בא כגון מ׳ שהוא וכ׳ is it permitted to raise animals (in Palestine)? Says R. Ba, Even an animal like mahir &c.; Y. Pes. IV, 30ᵈ bot. (corr. acc.); Y. B. Kam. VII, end, 6ᵃ (out of place).
